(3) The scene returns to the doctor at her desk, who continues to explain medical concepts while pointing at digital charts on her screen. (6) A high-contrast before-and-after comparison is shown, demonstrating a patient's skin improvement from severe spots to a much clearer complexion. (7) The final shot is a static information card showing the clinic's logo, social media handles, phone number, and physical addresses in New Taipei and Taipei.
